reasoning.step1:

2) Invoice date: located next to "Rechnungs-und               Lieferdatum:" -> "25/01/24". Use exactly as found: "25/01/24".

3) Sender VAT ID: found as "USt.-Ident-Nr:    DE814654220" (also appears near bank details). Extract "DE814654220".

4) Grand total: "Gesamt:               1,876.12" — numeric value 1,876.12 -> interpret as 1876.12 (preserve decimals).

5) Net amount: "Nettobetrag:                 1,576.57" -> 1576.57.

6) VAT amount: "USt     19.00%:                  299.55" -> VAT amount 299.55 and VAT rate 19.00% -> rate extracted as 19 (per rule: without %). Preserve decimals in amounts.

7) Consistency check: Net (1576.57) + VAT (299.55) = 1876.12 matches GrandTotal (1876.12). No conflicting multiple values found.
